words.headline: No Heat Complaints Double as New York Reaches for the Radiator
words.blurb: Monday's low dipped to 49 degrees, and 2,148 calls reported no heat or hot water, nearly double the usual 1,085. Meanwhile 41 people reported illegal fireworks, on a day that typically sees two.

boroughs.Bronx: Home repairs led with 836 calls, with 727 more asking where the heat went.
boroughs.Brooklyn: Parking wars ruled the borough with 1,238 calls about curbs and cars.
boroughs.Manhattan: Home repairs topped the list at 579, with no-heat calls close behind at 519.
boroughs.Queens: Parking wars took the crown with 937 calls, more than double home repairs.
boroughs.Staten Island: Parking wars led with 92 calls, followed by 57 about street fixes.

rare_finds.name: Micromobility device store: e-bike sold or leased without safety certification
rare_finds.quip: The city has a form for this. Not bikes. Not e-bikes. E-bikes that were LEASED without a certificate. Someone drafted that dropdown.

rare_finds.name: Flyer or handbill: utility pole
rare_finds.quip: A piece of paper, on a pole. Filed, logged, routed to a department. Somewhere a lost-cat flyer now has an official case number.

rare_finds.name: Removing wildlife: bird
rare_finds.quip: What's the deal with removing a bird? It has wings! It IS the removal system. And yet, one Monday, the city got the call anyway.
